addLink.description: The link message in the context menu.

addPage.description: The message in the context menu.

advancedOptions.description: The label for the advanced options dropdown

allButton.description: Button to show all reading items

animation.description: The label for the animation option.

appDesc.message: This extension saves a list of links to pages to read later.
appDesc.description: The description of the application, displayed in the web store.

appName.description: The title of the application, displayed in the web store and in the popup’s heading.

backupRestore.description: Heading of the export/import section on the options page.

clearData.description: The label for the button to clear all the reading list items

confirmMsg.message: You are about to delete everything in the reading list. Are you sure?
confirmMsg.description: Message to ensure user knows they are deleting all app data

context.description: The label for the context option.

copied.description: Button label after the diagnostics report was copied.

copyToClipboard.description: Button that copies the storage diagnostics report.

defaultBehavior.description: Label above the default-behavior checkboxes on the options page.

deleteItem.description: Accessible label for an item's delete (×) button.

diagnosticsFailed.description: Shown in place of the diagnostics report when generating it fails. $ERROR$ is the error text.

diagnosticsNote.message: Contains counts and sizes only - no page addresses or titles - so it's safe to send in a bug report.
diagnosticsNote.description: Privacy note shown above the storage diagnostics report.

downloadLocalBackup.description: Button that downloads the automatic local backup made before a data migration.

editTitle.description: Accessible label for an item's edit (pencil) button.

importComplete.description: Alert after a fully successful import. $COUNT$ is the number of items added.

importDiagnostics.description: Appended to the partial import alert. $DIAGNOSTICS$ is a short technical summary.

importFailed.description: Alert when importing throws. $ERROR$ is the error text.

importFirstError.description: Appended to the partial import alert. $ERROR$ is the first error message.

importInvalidFile.description: Alert when the chosen import file has an unrecognised format.

importPartial.description: Alert after a partly failed import. $SUCCEEDED$ imported, out of $TOTAL$, $FAILED$ failed.

loadFailed.message: Converting your reading list to the new format failed. Your saved pages are still safe in storage — open Options (the gear icon above) → Advanced to download a backup.
loadFailed.description: Shown when the initial reading list load fails, e.g. a storage quota error during the one-time migration from the old extension.

noLocalBackup.message: No local backup found yet. One is saved automatically before the extension migrates data from an older version.
noLocalBackup.description: Alert shown when Download Local Backup is clicked but no backup exists.

openNewTab.description: Label for the option to open a new tab when a link is clicked

openSidebar.description: Accessible label for the Sidebar button.

options.description: Accessible label for the gear button that opens the Options page.

optionsTitle.description: The title of the application's options menu.

pageActionOption.description: The label for the address bar option.

removePage.description: The title of the address bar button when the page is already on the list.

reviewRequest.message: Like the Reading List? Give us a review!
reviewRequest.description: Title of the review-request item shown at the top of the list.

search.description: The label for the search box.

sidebar.description: Popup header button that opens the sidebar or side panel.

storageDiagnostics.description: Button that shows the storage diagnostics report.

syncFailed.message: Couldn't save that change. Your list may be full, so try removing some pages.
syncFailed.description: Shown briefly when a reading list write (e.g. reordering) fails to save.

unreadButton.description: Button to show unread reading items.
